title: Israeli Strike on Apartment West of Gaza City Wounds Children
detail: Israeli forces targeted an apartment building west of Gaza City; children were among those wounded in the strike, according to Palestinian reports and Middle East Eye.

media.caption: Israeli forces targeted an apartment building west of Gaza City

title: Israeli Settlers Burn House Near Nablus in West Bank
detail: Palestinian reports indicate Israeli settlers burned a house in a village near Nablus in the occupied West Bank, continuing a pattern of settler attacks on Palestinian communities.

title: China Calls for International Action at UN Over West Bank Crisis
detail: China called for international action at the United Nations after warnings of a worsening humanitarian and security situation in the West Bank, urging the international community to intervene.

title: Israeli Settlers Divert West Bank Spring Water Sources, Seize Heritage Sites
detail: Far-right Israeli settlers in the West Bank are diverting spring water sources as part of a broader pattern of heritage site takeovers backed by Israeli authorities, according to investigative reporting.

title: Wave of Settler Attacks in West Bank: Homes Burned, IDF Troops Stoned, Roads Blocked
detail: Israeli settlers launched a broad wave of attacks across the West Bank: burning Palestinian homes and vehicles, stoning Israeli soldiers — a rare incident drawing condemnation from PM Netanyahu, Knesset members, and President Herzog — and blocking roads near Ramallah. Settlers also attacked Palestinians in multiple villages. Israeli forces conducted parallel raids and mass arrests across the West Bank.

title: Red Cross Says West Bank Life Is 'Intolerable' for Palestinians
detail: The International Committee of the Red Cross described conditions in the West Bank as 'intolerable' for Palestinians, citing ongoing settler violence and Israeli settlement expansion as the primary drivers of deteriorating humanitarian conditions.

sources.name: International Committee of the Red Cross

title: Pakistan UN Envoy Calls for End to Israeli Settler Violence, Urges Palestinian Statehood
detail: Pakistan's ambassador to the United Nations called for an immediate end to Israeli settler violence in the West Bank and reiterated support for Palestinian statehood, as settler attacks drew international condemnation at the Security Council.
